acceptanceScope: single-security, single-announcement-date; not full history or universe coverage

legacyKeyProbe.policy: reject a response whose records collide under the checked-in QuestDB dedup key; do not silently discard plan/progress variants

compatibility.nullEndDate: normalized to legacy sentinel "unknown" before business-key validation
compatibility.reason: isolated acceptance table generated from the Java contract; the production table schema was not probed

credentialHandling: token read in memory from local application.yml; omitted from report and artifacts
limitations: One security and one announcement date only
No complete monthly/backfill schedule or checkpoint
No parity comparison with frozen legacy Python output
A collision-bearing source window remains blocked until ownership/key semantics are resolved
